newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal signs up model Claudia Schiffer.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal signs up model Claudia Schiffer.

text.p: French cosmetics giant L'Oreal has signed up golden-haired supermodel Claudia Schiffer to add a touch of glamour to its mass market hair care line Elseve.
"Claudia Schiffer will be a magnificent spokeswoman for L'Oreal Paris products," Patrick Rabain, vice president of L'Oreal's mass market division, said in a statement.
L'Oreal said Schiffer, who previously pitched for Revlon, would initially sell Elseve hair products under an exclusive advertising contract whose terms were not disclosed.
Schiffer joins an illustrious cast working for L'Oreal, whose brands range from the upscale Lancome and Biotherm marques to the more accessible Vichy and Maybelline lines.

Acclaimed Chinese actress Gong Li sells L'Oreal products in China and southeast Asia. Oscar winner Juliette Binoche launched Lancome's perfume 'Poeme'. Cristiana Reali replaced Isabella Rossellini as the new face of Lancome cosmetics, and Andie MacDowell advertises for L'Oreal.
